claim: .RADIX 16 is set once in the shared rev-1 include CENDEF, inherited by every CPU module that .INCLUDEs it.
Rev 4's equivalent shared include CENDE4 sets the same .RADIX 16.
The picture-data module CENPIC, assembled separately (not linked), sets its own .RADIX 16.
The sync-PROM module SYNC, assembled separately, sets its own .RADIX 16.
COIN65, assembled separately, sets its own .RADIX 16 (space-indented in this file).
COIN65 restores the caller's radix on exit.
NCENT, the segment-count equate, carries a trailing period, so 12. is decimal twelve even inside a hex-radix file.
CMP I,37. compares against decimal 37 inside the otherwise-hex CENIRQ module.
